promptPlaceholder.t2v: Describe the shot: subject, action, setting, camera movement, sound…
promptPlaceholder.i2v: Describe how the image comes alive: who does what, how the camera moves, what you hear…
promptPlaceholder.flf2v: Describe what happens between the first and the last image…
promptPlaceholder.ref2v: First describe who or what each reference shows, then what happens: Reference sheet: … Generated video: …

form.promptTip: English prompts work best; Chinese also works
form.enhanceHint: Expands your prompt automatically; adds 1–2 minutes per clip
form.extendPick: Choose a finished video from your history
form.extendNone: Nothing to extend yet — generate a video first
form.needSource: Choose a video to extend first
form.referencesTip: Use 1–12 images; they are arranged into one black reference sheet for the AI. Fewer, tightly cropped images (e.g. just the character) reconstruct best — crop empty space around full-body shots.
form.needReferences: Add at least one reference image

feed.title: History
feed.emptyTitle: Turn one sentence into your first video
feed.emptyBody: Everything runs on your computer: no uploads, no credits, no subscription.
feed.example1: A Taipei street at dusk, neon signs reflected on wet asphalt after the rain, scooters passing slowly, the camera gently pushes in
feed.example2: A red paper lantern swaying in the evening breeze, soft bokeh lights, gentle wind chimes
feed.example3: A swordswoman in a deep blue hanfu stands in a bamboo forest, the wind stirs the leaves, she slowly draws her sword as the camera circles her

toast.addedMany: Added {{count}} clips to the timeline in order
toast.noDesktop: AI generation needs the Flameblade Cut desktop app
toast.engineFailed: Could not start the AI engine: {{message}}

director.title: Director
director.subtitle: One line per shot. Generate the whole sequence at once, then drop it on the timeline in order.
director.emptyBody: Write it like a shot list: one line per shot. Add a start image to any shot to keep characters and places consistent.
director.tip: Tip: repeat each character's look (hair, outfit, colours) in every shot so they stay recognisably the same person.

settings.title: AI engine settings
settings.description: Flameblade Cut generates video with ComfyUI and LTX-2.5 on your own computer.
settings.preLaunchHint: For example, to close other local AI apps that use GPU memory
settings.libraryHint: New videos are saved here, one sub-folder per day. Use "Save as" to put any single video elsewhere.

model.label: Main model

options.auto: Automatic (best installed model for your GPU)
options.int8: INT8 · RTX 30/40 series and other NVIDIA GPUs
options.bf16: BF16 · full precision, largest file (about 42 GB)

model.autoHint: Uses NVFP4 on RTX 50 series, INT8 on other GPUs, and BF16 if neither is installed. Time estimates were measured on an RTX 5060 Ti with NVFP4; other setups differ.
model.fileHint: Needs the model file {{file}} (in ComfyUI's models/diffusion_models).

translate.toggleHint: LTX draws objects, colours and counts more accurately from English; your original text stays in the history
translate.noChinese: No Chinese in the prompt; it is sent as written
translate.openaiNoKey: No OpenAI key yet; add one in Settings → API Keys
translate.localNote: The first use downloads the translation model ({{size}}); after that it works offline
translate.previewEmpty: Press “Preview translation” to see the English that will be sent; you can edit it and your version is sent as is
translate.edited: Edited by you; this English is sent as is
translate.stale: The Chinese changed; it will be translated again when you generate
translate.directorHint: Each shot is translated with this setting

model.missing: The LTX-2.5 main model file was not found. Download the version for your GPU from Lightricks/LTX-2.5 on Hugging Face (NVFP4 for RTX 50 series, INT8 otherwise) into ComfyUI's models/diffusion_models, or choose an installed model in the AI engine settings.
model.nvfp4-unsupported: Your GPU cannot run the NVFP4 model (RTX 50 series only). Download the INT8 main model, or choose INT8 in the AI engine settings.
